title: External Casting Adapter Boundary
problem: Nako has host-owned cast-safe renderer media transport, but Chromecast, DLNA, and AirPlay still need a sidecar adapter boundary for discovery and protocol control.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-server -E 'test(renderer_adapter) | test(renderer) | test(playback)' --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the external casting adapter boundary lane and ADR 0042, choosing sidecar renderer adapters for Chromecast, DLNA, and AirPlay while keeping host-owned policy, sessions, and cast-safe media transport.
Locked the current external casting boundary: Public renderer registration rejects Chromecast/DLNA/AirPlay targets, Admin keeps those adapters planned, and diagnostics stay redaction-safe.

continue_policy.notes: Run ECAB-030 next to add the host renderer adapter bridge contract before any real protocol implementation.
